# BulkX

> BulkX is a high-volume buyer of English Pokémon bulk cards from collectors, card stores, breakers, online sellers, distributors, and warehouse inventories.

BulkX purchases bulk cards throughout the United States. Approved shipments may also be accepted from Canada and Mexico.

## Primary Pages

- [BulkX Home and Buylist](https://bulkx.gg/): Current buylist pricing, payout calculator, accepted card categories, seller requirements, shipping overview, and quote submission.
- [Shipping Instructions](https://bulkx.gg/shipping-instructions.html): Instructions for preparing, sorting, packing, and shipping Pokémon bulk cards.
- [Request a Quote](https://bulkx.gg/#quote): Submit card quantities and contact information for a purchase quote.

## Cards Purchased

BulkX purchases large quantities of:

- Common and uncommon cards
- Reverse Holo cards
- Holo Rare cards
- Pokémon ex cards
- Pokémon V cards

English cards are preferred unless otherwise approved. Cards should generally be Mint or Near Mint and separated by category.

## Suitable Sellers

BulkX works with:

- Local game stores
- Online card sellers
- Breakers
- Collection buyers
- Convention vendors
- Bulk resellers
- Distributors
- Warehouse inventories
- Store liquidations
- Large private collections
- Hobbyists

Recurring inventory relationships are welcome.

## Selling Process

1. Review the current buylist.
2. Submit inventory quantities for a quote.
3. Receive shipping or freight-pickup instructions.
4. Ship the cards or schedule an approved pickup.
5. BulkX verifies the inventory.
6. Payment is issued according to the approved transaction terms.

## Freight Pickup

Free freight pickup may be available for qualifying Pokémon bulk collections of approximately 250,000 cards or more.

Eligibility depends on card quantity, card mix, collection value, seller location, sorting, and condition.

## Important Information

- Pricing may change with market conditions.
- Sellers should verify current pricing on the official BulkX website.
- Inventory should be sorted by card category.
- Quote approval is required before cross-border shipping or pallet pickup.
